… complete sets of A.A.A. track championship medals at 2 and 7 miles besides numerous National and International awards. Mrs. Churcher has most generously handed these to the Club and it was your Committee's wish that these should be held in trust for her.…
A selection of medals won by this great Belgravian are now on display in the clubroom and we are particularly indebted to Mrs. Churcher for enabling us to put these medals on show.

THE CLUB have been pleased to accept the kind offer of Mrs. Churcher of the late Harry Churcher's medals and have agreed to hold them in trust during her life time, after which they will become the property of the Club.
